body:
### 🚪jwAutoDoors — Forget About Manual Door Opening Forever!

Have you ever thought about how many split seconds you waste constantly clicking on doors when returning to your base with an inventory full of resources? **jwAutoDoors** is an ultra-lightweight, super-optimized, and smart mod that completely automates this routine.

Doors will smoothly open right in front of your nose and neatly close behind your back. No pressure plates messing up your interior design, and absolutely no redstone spam!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DPJZr0tAEWo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## ✨ Key Features & Perks:

* **⚡ Smart Step-Based Caching (0 Lag):** Unlike other mods that constantly scan the world and tank your CPU, jwAutoDoors utilizes an advanced step-based caching system. The mod only "thinks" when you actually move.
* **🎵 Anti-Spam Buffer Zone (+0.5 blocks):** Doors won't start slamming or spamming sounds if you decide to stand right on the threshold. The closing zone is slightly extended for your ultimate comfort.
* **👥 Multiplayer Safe:** A door will never slam in your friend's face! The mod carefully verifies the positions of all nearby players before closing a block.
* **🛠️ In-Game Configuration Screen:** Adjust the activation distance (from 1 to 5 blocks) or completely disable automation for specific door types right in the game via the ModMenu interface.
* **🌍 Full Localization:** The interface seamlessly supports dynamic switching between **English** and **Russian** languages.

---

## ⚙️ Installation & Requirements

1. Download the latest **Fabric API** and drop it into your `mods` folder.
2. *(Highly Recommended)* Install **ModMenu** to get access to the gorgeous graphical config screen.
3. Place the **jwAutoDoors** .jar file into your `mods` folder and enjoy the comfort!
